title.narrative: Anhui Xuancheng Infrastructure for Industry Relocation

description.narrative: The objective of the Anhui Xuancheng Infrastructure for Industry Relocation Project for China is to contribute to the economic, social and environmental sustainability of the project area in the Xuancheng economic and technological development zone. There are three components to the project, the first component being roads and bridges with underground storm-water drainage networks, water supply networks, and sewerage networks. This component supports the construction of selected urban roads in the project area, along with bus stations and stops, landscaping, and associated sub-surface infrastructure services, including storm water drainage, water supply and sewage networks. The second component is the wastewater conveyance, treatment and discharge. This component supports construction of conveyance sewers and treated effluent pipes to and from the wastewater treatment plant, as well as construction of associated treated effluent outfalls. Finally, the third component is the institutional development and capacity building.
The project aims to contribute to the economic, social and environmental sustainability of the project area in the Xuancheng Economic and Technological Development Zone.

condition.narrative: Finance Agreement :PA Section I, A.4 | Description :XETDZ MC shall furnish to the Bank, for approval, a prospective annual work andbudget plan for the Project by December 15 of each year of Project implementation, commencing on December 15, 2014, includingdetails on the planned program of activities, procurementplan and budget for the following calendar year in form and substance asset forth in the Operational Manual. | Frequency :Yearly

Finance Agreement :PA Section I, A.4 | Description :XETDZ MC shall, by September 15, 2013, furnish to the Bank, for approval, aninitial work and budget plan covering the first seventeen months of Project Implementation, including details on the plannedprogram of activities, procurement plan and budget for such prospective period in form and substance as set forth in theOperational Manual. | Due Date :15-Sep-2013

Finance Agreement :PA Section II, A.1 | Description :XETDZ MC shall monitor and evaluate the progress of the Project and prepareProject Reports on the basis of indicators agreed with the Bank and set forth in the Operational Manual. Each such Project Reportshall cover the period of one calendar semester, and shall be furnished to the Borrower and to the Bank not later than 45 daysafter the end of the period covered by such report. | Frequency :Yearly

Finance Agreement :PA Section II, B.2 | Description :XETDZ MC shall prepare and furnish to the Bank, as part of the Project Report,interim unaudited financial reports for the Project covering the semester, in form and substance satisfactory to the Bank. |Frequency :Yearly

Finance Agreement :PA Section II, B.3 | Description :XETDZ MC shall have its financial statements referred to above audited byindependent auditors acceptable to the Bank annually. XETDZ MC shall ensure that the audited financial statements for each periodshall be (a) furnished to the Borrower and the Bank not later than six months after the end of the period; and (b) made publiclyavailable in a timely fashion and in a manner. | Frequency :Yearly

Finance Agreement :PA Section IV, A.1 | Description :XETDZ MC shall have entered into a contract for the construction and at least5 years of operation and maintenance of the wastewater treatment plant of the Project, with an entity or entities duly qualified toperform such tasks, all under terms and conditions acceptable to the Bank. | Due Date :30-Jun-2014

Finance Agreement :PA Section IV, A.2 | Description :For each of the Borrower's fiscal years starting 2018, the WastewaterTreatment Plant, should have total revenues equivalent to notless than its total operating expenses, excluding depreciation. |Frequency :Yearly

comment.narrative:
<p>Overachieved (125% of final target). The indicator was introduced in the 2018 restructuring.</p>

<p>The result was to be achieved by a wastewater management system in the project area. This was achieved by constructing a sewerage collection network and aWWTP.</p>

<p>Source: Project monitoring documents, wastewater operations monitoring reports, and the Borrower’s completion report.</p>

<p>Target overachieved (110% of final target). Original indicator.</p>

<p>The result was to be achieved by sufficient firms locating in the XETDZ. This was achieved by financing infrastructure, management tools, and capacity building in the project area / for the park administration.</p>

<p>Source: Project monitoring documents (statistics) and the Borrower’s completion report. </p>

<p>Target overachieved (108% of final target). Original indicator.</p>

<p>The result was to be achieved by promoting and incentivizing firms to relocate to the XETDZ</p>

<p>This was achieved by financing infrastructure and establishing supporting systems such as the investment promotion system and the labor information system, and building human capacity in the Zone administration to support the operational needs of the firms in the project area, as required and appropriate.</p>

<p>Source: Project monitoring documents (statistics) and the Borrower’s completion report.</p>

title.narrative: Women as percentage of net employment created

comment.narrative:
<p>Target overachieved (104% of final target). Original indicator.</p>

<p>The result was to be achieved by firms in the XETDZbeing encouraged and supported to employ women.</p>

<p>This was achieved by implementing a labor information system including specific functions to attract women employees, and promoting equitable access to opportunity, services, and incomes; arranging women-focused job fairs and some technical training for women; and by both the labor market information system and the XETDZ M&E system being gender-inclusive.</p>

<p>Source: Project monitoring documents (statistics) and the Borrower’s completion report. </p>

title.narrative: Volume(mass) of BOD pollution load removed by treatment plant under the project

comment.narrative:
<p>Target was not achieved because (i) the sewerage volume received by the WWTP was lower than anticipated; and (ii) the Zone Administration established high environmental standards for the firms located in the industrial park. This resulted in the pollution level in collected wastewater being much lower than originally anticipated. (24% of final target; proportionally to the sewerage volume received, this is a much lower pollution level than the target.)</p>

<p>Original indicator.</p>

<p>The result was to be achieved by a wastewater management system in the project area. This was achieved by constructing an effective WWTP and a related sewerage collection network. </p>

<p>Source: Project monitoring (construction supervision) documents, WWTP operations monitoring reports, and the Borrower’s completion report. </p>

title.narrative: Number of XETDZ staff formally trained

comment.narrative:
<p>Target overachieved (356% of final target). Original indicator.</p>

<p>The result was to be achieved by providing relevanttraining to the Zone Administration staff for their project management and selective park management functions.</p>

<p>This was achieved by arranging training events and study tours. </p>

<p>Source: Project monitoring documents and the Borrower’s completion report.</p>

<p>Overachieved (104% of final target). Original indicator.</p>

<p>The result was to be achieved by constructing roads acrossthe project area. This was achieved by financing non-rural roads with underground infrastructure.</p>

<p>Source: Project monitoring (construction supervision) documents and the Borrower’s completion report. </p>

title.narrative: Women as percentage of persons trained

comment.narrative:
<p>Target overachieved (210% of final target). Original indicator.</p>

<p>The result was to be achieved by encouraging femalestaff of the Zone Administration to participate in training events and study tours. This was achieved by outreach across the Zone Administration.      </p>

<p>Source: Project monitoring documents and the Borrower’s completion report.</p>

<p>Target overachieved (113% of final target). Original indicator.</p>

<p>The result was to be achieved by sufficient firms locating in the XETDZ. This was achieved by financing infrastructure, management tools, and capacity building in the project area / for the park administration.</p>

<p>Source: Project monitoring documents (statistics) and the Borrower’s completion report. </p>

<p>Target overachieved (106% of final target). The indicator was introduced in the 2018 restructuring.</p>

<p>The result was to be achieved by implementing infrastructure and providing a range of adequate support from the park administration. This was achieved.</p>

<p>Source: Project Social Economic Impact Survey (PSEIS) results (a survey conducted on four occasions).</p>

title.narrative: Ratio of water quality compliance under monitoring

comment.narrative:
<p>Overachieved (115% of final target). The indicator was introduced in the 2018 restructuring.</p>

<p>The result was to be achieved by monitoring the water quality of the Changqiao river running through the project area.</p>

<p>This was achieved by establishing multiple monitoring sub-stations and implementing online data monitoring of the water quality in the main rivers, including downstream of the WWTP. Monitoring processes were conducted every six months on four, particularly environmentally sensitive river sections.</p>

<p>Source: Environmental monitoring system data and the Borrower’s completion report.</p>

title.narrative: Volume of wastewater treated per day to standard Class 1A

comment.narrative:
<p>Overachieved (300% of final target). Original indicator.</p>

<p>The result was to be achieved by implementing a WWTP with sufficient treatment capacity for the expected sewerage flow. This was achieved by the constructed WWTP (and the sewerage flow in the collection network). </p>

<p>Source: WWTP monitoring documents and the Borrower’s completion report. </p>

title.narrative: Number of people in urban areas provided with access to Improved Water Sources under the project

comment.narrative:
<p>Overachieved (105% of final target). Original indicator.</p>

<p>The result was to be achieved by a new water supply network in the project area. This was achieved by constructing a water supply network, partly under the roads being constructed across theproject area.</p>

<p>Source: Project monitoring (construction supervision) documents and the Borrower’s completion report. </p>

title.narrative: People provided with access to "improved sanitation facilities under the proj.

comment.narrative:
<p>Overachieved (105% of final target). Original indicator.</p>

<p>The result was to be achieved by a wastewater management system in the project area. This was achieved by constructing a WWTP and a related sewerage collection network. </p>

<p>Source: Project monitoring (construction supervision) documents and the Borrower’s completion report. </p>

title.narrative: Rollout of a labor market information system

comment.narrative:
<p>Achieved. Original indicator.</p>

<p>The result was to be achieved by developing and implementing a system including supply and demand data, to help existing and new firms in the industrial park to find the employees they needed, particularly supporting their recruitment of skilled labor. This was achieved by implementing such a system in the relevant units of the Zone Administration</p>

<p>Source: Project monitoring documents and the Borrower’s completion report.</p>

<p> </p>

title.narrative: Rollout of enhanced XEDTZ internal monitoring and evaluation system

comment.narrative:
<p>Achieved. Original indicator.</p>

<p>The result was to be achieved by developing and implementing an internal M&E system for the Zone Administration.</p>

<p>This was achieved by developing a real-time M&E system, with data on more than 300 companies in its database (covering both the Phase 1 and Phase 2 areas), and with sensors installed in the enterprises considered by the Zone Administration to be key polluters. Sensors were also placed in waterways/water sources, air quality stations, and stormwater and solid waste management facilities. Additional data was collected through the PSEIS to further monitor project outcomes, and to providefurther evidence of the project’s achievements. The system was implemented in the relevant units of the Zone Administration.</p>

<p>Source: Project monitoring documents and the Borrower’s completion report.</p>

title.narrative: Rollout of an intelligent investment promotion system

comment.narrative:
<p>Achieved. Original indicator.</p>

<p>The result was to be achieved by developing and implementing the system including a screening process. This was achieved by implementing such a system in the relevant units of the Zone Administration.</p>

<p>Source: Project monitoring documents and the Borrower’s completion report.</p>

title.narrative: Rollout of a real time environmental monitoring system

comment.narrative:
<p>Target achieved. Original indicator.</p>

<p>The result was to be achieved by developing and implementing such a system in the Zone Administration.</p>

<p>This was achieved by implementing an advanced ICT-based real-time environmental monitoring and early warning system, for air, land, and water pollution; urban noise; and related potential emergency situations (with mobile access and numerous monitoring points in the Zone, including in enterprises).</p>

<p>Source: Project monitoring documents and the Borrower’s completion report.</p>
